items.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
items.description: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.

items.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
items.description: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

items.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
items.description: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".

items.title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
items.description: Lionel Messi's father and agent Jorge dies at the age of 68 following a long illness.

items.title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
items.description: The Queen of Pop worked with Orbit several times over the years, most notably on her genre-bending, Grammy Award-winning album Ray of Light.

items.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
items.description: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.

items.title: Paris tells e-scooter riders to wear safety gear or face fines
items.description: Police in the French capital tighten rules for riders after a sharp increase in fatal accidents.

items.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
items.description: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from  Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

items.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
items.description: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

items.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
items.description: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.

items.title: Fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size forcing thousands to flee homes
items.description: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread to more than 36 sq miles (95 sq km).

items.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
items.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.
